title-group.article-title: GATA1 knockdown lowers GENE1 expression in invented erythroid cells

abstract.p: We describe invented knockdown experiments on GATA1 and TAL1 and their effect on GENE1 for software tests.

sec.title: Knockdown of two factors
sec.p: siRNA knockdown of GATA1 in K562 cells lowered GENE1 mRNA by half, as measured by qPCR. The cells remained viable.
In contrast, siRNA knockdown of TAL1 in K562 cells did not change GENE1 mRNA.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Earlier work had suggested that GATA1 regulates GENE1.
